projects.name: Diplomatic Cable Provenance Project
projects.summary: Catalogs the origin, classification level, and transmission history of leaked diplomatic cables to support provenance verification by researchers and journalists. Outputs feed reference databases used to authenticate cited documents in academic and policy work.

projects.name: Geneva Conventions Treaty Translation Project
projects.summary: Maintains accurate, side-by-side translations of the Geneva Conventions and their Additional Protocols across UN working languages. Deliverables support legal scholars and humanitarian organizations referencing treaty text in multiple jurisdictions.

projects.name: UN Security Council Resolutions Archive Project
projects.summary: Builds a structured archive of UN Security Council resolutions with metadata on sponsors, voting records, and thematic tags. The archive is used as a reference layer for analysts tracking enforcement actions and sanctions regimes.

projects.name: WikiLeaks Disclosure Timeline Project
projects.summary: Compiles a verified chronological timeline of major WikiLeaks disclosures, including release dates, document categories, and associated source material. The timeline supports journalists, historians, and oversight bodies tracking the evolution of public-interest leaks.

phases.name: Executive Briefing Phase
phases.summary: Produces concise briefing materials summarizing key disclosure dates and their significance for senior stakeholders and external partners.

phases.name: Initial Scoping Phase
phases.summary: Defines the inventory of WikiLeaks releases to be included and establishes baseline dates, document types, and reference sources for each entry.

phases.name: Source Verification Phase
phases.summary: Cross-checks disclosure dates and document attributions against primary WikiLeaks records and reputable secondary reporting to confirm timeline accuracy.

phases.name: Actor Identification Phase

projects.name: Astronomical Almanac Compilation
projects.summary: A reference project assembling tabulated astronomical data such as planetary positions, lunar phases, and eclipse timings for an annual almanac publication. Work focuses on collating and verifying observational and ephemeris data from established astronomical sources.

projects.name: Middle East Incident Briefings
projects.summary: An open-source intelligence project producing concise briefings on notable security incidents across the Middle East, with emphasis on strikes, assassinations, and cross-border escalations. Each incident is processed through structured analytical phases before being written up for analyst consumption.

phases.name: Location Triangulation
phases.summary: Pinpoint the exact site of a reported incident by cross-referencing imagery, geotagged posts, and on-the-ground reporting to confirm coordinates and surrounding context.

phases.name: Source Verification
phases.summary: Validate the credibility of reports and claims about an incident by comparing official statements, reputable news outlets, and primary social media evidence.

phases.name: Suspect Shortlisting
phases.summary: Compile a vetted list of named individuals (perpetrators, targets, or casualties) tied to a confirmed incident, supported by corroborated reporting.

phases.name: Suspect Shortlisting (preliminary screening)
phases.summary: Initial scan of candidate names associated with an incident, drawing on early-stage reporting before fuller corroboration is applied in the main shortlisting phase.

projects.name: US Election Retrospective
projects.summary: An analytical project reviewing recent US election cycles, covering campaign milestones, polling shifts, and key political events. Outputs support post-election commentary and historical reference material.

projects.name: AviationIncidentReview
projects.summary: A research workstream that compiles and verifies facts surrounding notable civil and military aviation incidents. Outputs feed into briefing notes summarizing causes, casualties, and investigative findings.

projects.name: BangladeshProtestFactCheck
projects.summary: A fact-checking project focused on the 2024 Bangladesh quota reform movement and related unrest, aimed at producing a verified record of key events, dates, and casualty figures. Findings are intended to support journalistic and analytical write-ups on the protests.

phases.name: DataRetrieval

phases.name: ScopeFraming
phases.summary: Defining the temporal and thematic boundaries of the fact-check, including which dates, incidents, and actors fall within the movement's scope.

phases.name: SourceVerification
phases.summary: Cross-checking retrieved figures and claims against multiple independent sources to confirm accuracy before they are recorded as verified facts.

projects.name: ElectionResultsAudit
projects.summary: A review project that compiles official election outcomes and contested results across recent national votes. Deliverables include reconciled tallies and notes on disputes or irregularities.

projects.name: PoliticalTransitionTimeline
projects.summary: A project building structured timelines of recent political transitions, focusing on regime changes, leadership exits, and interim governments. The timelines support comparative analysis of how transitions unfold.

phases.name: RegimeMapping
phases.summary: Mapping the actors, offices, and dates involved in each transition to establish a clear before/after picture of governing authority.

projects.name: Cross-Source Fact Verification Sweep
projects.summary: A general-purpose project for confirming discrete factual claims by comparing reporting across multiple independent sources. Used to triage assertions that surface during broader research workstreams.

projects.name: Election Outcomes Audit
projects.summary: A project focused on documenting and verifying results, margins, and turnout from recent national and regional elections. Findings feed into longer-form analytical write-ups on political shifts.

projects.name: Notable Persons Movement Inquiry
projects.summary: A research project tracking the travel, relocation, release, and other physical movements of high-profile public figures whose whereabouts have news significance. Outputs include sourced timelines and short factual briefs suitable for downstream reporting.

phases.name: Audit Report Drafting
phases.summary: Consolidates verified findings about each subject's movements into a structured written report with citations.

phases.name: Preliminary Scoping
phases.summary: Identifies which notable persons and movement events fall within scope and defines the questions to be answered.

phases.name: Raw Source Compilation
phases.summary: Gathers primary news articles, official statements, and wire reports relevant to each subject's movements for later analysis.

phases.name: Single-Hop Fact Retrieval
phases.summary: Resolves direct, single-step factual questions about a notable person's movement, such as destination country or date of release, using a single authoritative source.

projects.name: CanadianHistoricalWeatherQA
projects.summary: A question-answering workstream that resolves factual queries about notable Canadian weather and severe-storm events using public historical records. Outputs are concise, sourced answers covering attributes such as dates, locations, intensities, and measured impacts.

phases.name: answer_delivery

phases.name: disaster_classification

phases.name: source_scoping

projects.name: ElectionResultsBriefing

phases.name: parallel_lookup
phases.summary: Phase in which multiple treaty entries are researched concurrently across reference sources to accelerate timeline assembly.

projects.name: BalkansLocalizationPilot
projects.summary: A pilot initiative to adapt reference materials and reporting templates for Western Balkans audiences, covering Bosnian, Croatian, and Serbian linguistic and historical context. The pilot scopes terminology, place-name conventions, and culturally sensitive event references.

projects.name: ElectionAlmanac
projects.summary: A reference compilation project documenting national and regional election results across multiple countries and decades. It aggregates results, turnout figures, and key dates into a structured almanac for downstream publication.

phases.name: StructuredExport
phases.summary: Phase focused on exporting validated election records into standardized tabular and JSON formats suitable for ingestion by analytics and publishing pipelines.

projects.name: PapalChronologyReview
projects.summary: An editorial review of papal succession dates, regnal events, and biographical milestones intended to reconcile discrepancies across historical sources. The project produces a canonical chronology for reference use.

phases.name: CrossValidation
phases.summary: Phase dedicated to cross-checking candidate dates and events against multiple independent historical sources to flag contradictions before sign-off.

projects.name: WarCrimesTimelineAudit
projects.summary: An audit project building a verified timeline of war crimes proceedings from the conflicts of the former Yugoslavia, including ICTY indictments, trials, verdicts, and appeals. Outputs support legal-historical research and journalistic fact-checking.

phases.name: EvidenceCollection
phases.summary: Phase gathering primary records such as ICTY judgments, court press releases, and case dockets that document indictments, convictions, and sentencing dates.

phases.name: SourceVerification
phases.summary: Phase confirming each timeline entry against at least one authoritative source, reconciling trial-chamber and appeals-chamber dates for the same defendant.

projects.name: AdultBMI-WellnessIntake
projects.summary: An adult wellness intake workflow that records basic anthropometric data (age, height, weight) and provides general BMI-based educational feedback for non-clinical wellness programs. The project supports routine adult check-ins where standard WHO BMI categories apply.

phases.name: EducationalBriefing
phases.summary: Provides general educational explanations of BMI, its categories, and how it is calculated for adults, without offering individualized medical advice.

phases.name: OnboardingDisclaimer
phases.summary: Presents disclaimers about the limits of BMI as a health indicator and confirms the participant understands the wellness, non-diagnostic nature of the intake.

phases.name: RawDataCollection
phases.summary: Collects raw participant inputs such as age, height in meters, and weight in kilograms, and may compute BMI and classify it against standard adult ranges.

projects.name: AviationSafety-RetroAnalysis
projects.summary: A retrospective analysis program reviewing historical aviation safety incidents and human-factors data to extract lessons learned. It is unrelated to clinical or anthropometric work and focuses on safety education.

phases.name: EducationalBriefing
phases.summary: Delivers background briefings on aviation safety concepts, incident taxonomies, and analytical frameworks used in the retrospective review.

projects.name: LatAm-NutritionOutreach
projects.summary: A community nutrition outreach initiative across Latin American regions focused on dietary education and population-level guidance. No active phases are currently defined for task execution.

projects.name: PediatricBMI-CohortStudy
projects.summary: A longitudinal cohort study tracking BMI and growth metrics in pediatric populations using age- and sex-specific percentile references rather than adult thresholds. No active phases are currently defined for task execution.

projects.name: BlairResignationAnnouncementInvestigation
projects.summary: A historical research project focused on the circumstances, timing, and political context surrounding Tony Blair's announcement that he would step down as Leader of the Labour Party and Prime Minister of the United Kingdom. Outputs support briefing notes and narrative writeups on the announcement and its immediate aftermath.

phases.name: ContextualizationPhase
phases.summary: Establishes the political and chronological backdrop of Blair's premiership leading up to the resignation announcement, including pressures within the Labour Party and key events of his final months in office.

phases.name: ExtendedNarrativeDraftingPhase
phases.summary: Produces longer-form narrative drafts recounting the announcement itself, the venue, wording, and reactions across the party and the public.

phases.name: TaskDecompositionPhase
phases.summary: Breaks down the broader investigation into discrete factual sub-questions (dates, locations, successor arrangements) to be researched and verified individually.

projects.name: FTSE100CEOSuccessionAudit
projects.summary: A corporate governance review examining leadership succession patterns and announcement practices among FTSE 100 chief executives. Findings are used as a comparative benchmark against high-profile political successions.

projects.name: MerkelChancellorshipTransitionStudy
projects.summary: A comparative political study of Angela Merkel's exit from the German Chancellorship, focusing on the timing, signalling, and orderly transition of power. Used alongside other leadership-exit case studies for cross-national analysis.

projects.name: ThatcherResignation1990Brief
projects.summary: A concise historical brief covering Margaret Thatcher's 1990 resignation as Prime Minister and Conservative Party Leader, prepared as a comparative case for other UK prime ministerial departures.

phases.name: SignificanceCommentaryPhase
phases.summary: Develops commentary on the political significance and long-term legacy of Thatcher's 1990 resignation, suitable for inclusion in comparative leadership-transition materials.

projects.name: HumanitarianCrisisTracker
projects.summary: An internal knowledge workstream that catalogs humanitarian impacts from armed conflicts, border incidents, and natural disasters. Outputs feed situational briefings for field teams and policy analysts who need concise, sourced context on affected regions.

phases.summary: Final stage where curated incident facts are packaged and handed to senior analysts for review. Emphasis is on accuracy of named parties, dates, and locations so downstream consumers can cite without rework.

projects.name: Coastal Fisheries Intelligence
projects.summary: An analyst workstream that traces fisher-reported catches back to verified anglers, port-side supply chains, and canonical species records along coastal regions. Outputs feed downstream catch-reporting and regional naming reconciliation systems.

phases.name: Angler Profile Verification
phases.summary: Confirm the identity and operating location of individual fishermen, including the ports and bait shops they are associated with.

phases.name: Localized Naming Pass
phases.summary: Resolve the local or regional common name of fish species tied to a specific coastal area.

phases.name: Multi-Hop Species Resolution
phases.summary: Chain references across bait source, angler, catch event, and area to identify the relevant fish species through multiple lookups.

phases.name: Structured Export Handoff
phases.summary: Package the resolved angler, area, and species details into a structured record for downstream consumers.

projects.name: AgriInnovationBenchmark

projects.name: Alpine Cheese Lineage Mapping
projects.summary: A heritage food research initiative documenting the provenance of alpine cheese varieties, tracing them from specific high-altitude pastures and dairies down to regional cheesemakers. The project compiles records on herd breeds, transhumance routes, and affinage traditions.

projects.name: Coastal Seafood Provenance Audit
projects.summary: An audit-style project verifying the origin chains of seafood served in coastal restaurants, linking fishing grounds and harbors to processors and end vendors. It focuses on resolving labeling discrepancies and confirming traceability claims.

projects.name: Orchard-to-Sweet Heritage Trace
projects.summary: A culinary provenance project that traces regional sweets back through their ingredient chains, particularly from orchards and on-site apiaries to local confectioners and the towns they operate in. The work establishes how orchard-derived honey is transformed into new confections and connects each sweet to the local food heritage of its city, including signature local nuts.

phases.name: Ambiguity Triage
phases.summary: Initial phase for identifying vague references in incoming queries (e.g., unspecified orchards, apiaries, or confectioners) and clarifying which heritage chain a request points to before deeper lookup.

phases.name: Source Discovery
phases.summary: Phase for locating and consolidating the underlying records on orchards, apiaries, confectioners, host cities, and their associated local nuts that support each traced sweet.

The project links port origin to final plated dish, identifying the responsible chef and the city where the dish is served.

phases.name: FinalAnswerSynthesis
phases.summary: Consolidate findings across earlier phases into a single grounded answer about the dish, chef, and associated city characteristics.

phases.name: PortDiscovery
phases.summary: Identify the relevant port within the delta and the seafood it supplies to downstream chefs.

phases.name: ToolInventoryAudit
phases.summary: Review the available retrieval and lookup tools to confirm coverage for ports, chefs, dishes, and city-level local spice data.

projects.name: MountainStoneSurvey
projects.summary: A parallel geological reference project cataloging stone types from mountain regions for cross-domain location lookups. It is currently dormant with no active phases.

projects.name: SupplierMappingInitiative
projects.summary: A broad effort to map regional suppliers (seafood, spice, produce) to the cities and chefs they serve. Serves as a shared reference layer for culinary tracing projects but has no active phases at this time.

projects.name: ConflictMortalityAtlas

projects.name: Coastal Heritage Mapping Initiative
projects.summary: A cross-disciplinary effort to catalog coastal and island cultural heritage sites, linking ecological landmarks with the communities that steward them. Outputs feed downstream cultural and biodiversity reviews.

projects.name: Cultural Soundscapes Audit
projects.summary: An audit program documenting traditional music, dance, and ambient soundscapes tied to specific islands and coastal communities. It produces structured reference material used by cultural researchers and educators.

phases.name: Island Dance Synthesis
phases.summary: Compiles and synthesizes documented local dance traditions per island, including names, origins, and associated communities, into a reference catalog.

phases.name: Soundscape Cataloging
phases.summary: Organizes field recordings and metadata of island soundscapes, indexing them by location, season, and cultural context.

projects.name: Island Landmark Survey
projects.summary: A survey project identifying notable natural and cultural landmarks across islands relevant to heritage and conservation work. Results support verification of place-based references used in other initiatives.

phases.name: Landmark Verification
phases.summary: Cross-checks reported island landmarks against authoritative sources and field records to confirm names, locations, and associated cultural attributes.

projects.name: Philanthropy Impact Review 2023
projects.summary: An annual review tracing major philanthropic donations to conservation and cultural causes, including zoos, aquariums, and marine research programs. It links donors to founded or funded institutions and their downstream ecological focus areas.

phases.name: Donor Financial Audit
phases.summary: Reviews donor contribution records, recipient institutions, and the conservation initiatives or facilities they founded or supported.

phases.name: Public Briefing Drafts
phases.summary: Prepares public-facing summaries of donor impact, highlighting founded institutions such as zoos and aquariums and their featured exhibits.

projects.name: CuisineHeritageTrace
projects.summary: A research initiative that traces well-known regional desserts and dishes back to their cities and cultural origins. It supports cross-referencing culinary heritage with geographic and historical context for downstream chained reasoning tasks.

phases.name: regional_validation
phases.summary: Validates that a given dish or dessert is canonically associated with a specific city or region, confirming the cuisine-to-location mapping before it is used in larger reasoning chains.

projects.name: OlympicMedalChainAnalysis
projects.summary: An analytical project that builds multi-hop reasoning chains starting from Olympic medal records and athletes, linking them to countries, policies, and broader historical contexts. It serves as a sibling workflow to other chain-analysis projects, sharing common decomposition and validation patterns.

projects.name: PolarChainAnalysis
projects.summary: A multi-hop reasoning project anchored on polar exploration history, chaining from explorers and the regions they reached to the natural resources, industries, economic theories, policies, and cultural facts connected to those regions. projects.name: Beverage Catalog Enrichment
projects.summary: An internal initiative to expand and standardize metadata across the company's beverage product catalog, including herbal teas, infusions, and specialty drinks. The project compiles ingredient origins, producer profiles, and marketing tie-ins to support cross-referencing with partner brands.

projects.name: Coastal Fisheries Heritage Audit
projects.summary: A regional audit documenting traditional coastal fishing practices, community heritage assets, and historical catch records. The work supports cultural preservation reporting and informs sustainable fisheries policy recommendations.

projects.name: Cultural-Sports-Science Linkage Resolution
projects.summary: A research project that traces multi-hop connections between local sports sponsorships, the corporate beverage producers behind them, the botanical and genetic science underpinning their ingredients, and the cultural traditions of the regions involved. Outputs feed a knowledge graph used to answer complex linkage queries across cultural, sporting, and scientific domains.

phases.name: Post-Mortem Review
phases.summary: Retrospective analysis of completed linkage cases to capture lessons learned, source reliability notes, and improvements for future chained-entity resolutions.

phases.name: Preliminary Scoping
phases.summary: Initial framing of a linkage query, identifying the entity chain to be resolved and the candidate sources for sponsorship, ingredient, scientific discovery, and cultural data.

phases.name: Sponsorship Verification Drill
phases.summary: Focused checks confirming which company sponsors a given local sports team and the products that company produces, used as the anchor step for downstream ingredient and science lookups.

projects.name: European Trade Fair Mapping
projects.summary: A mapping exercise cataloging major European trade fairs relevant to food, beverage, and cultural exports. The project records exhibitor profiles, regional sponsorships, and scheduling to support business development outreach.

projects.name: AcademicSourceVerification
projects.summary: A workstream focused on cross-checking factual claims against scholarly and reference sources to confirm accuracy before publication. It supports downstream QA pipelines by flagging unreliable citations and reconciling discrepancies between sources.

projects.name: GeoFactsQA
projects.summary: An initiative that answers natural-language geography questions by chaining lookups across explorers, landmarks, parks, and administrative regions. The pipeline emphasizes correctly resolving multi-hop references before producing a final answer.

phases.name: concise-answer-delivery
phases.summary: Final-stage formatting that returns the resolved fact (e.g., a population figure or place name) as a short, direct response suitable for end users.

phases.name: landmark-disambiguation
phases.summary: Resolves ambiguous landmark references such as waterfalls or peaks named after historical figures, ensuring the correct named feature is selected before further lookups.

phases.name: park-profile-compilation
phases.summary: Gathers structured details about a national or state park, including its location, containing county, and notable features, to support downstream regional queries.

phases.name: region-coordinate-normalization
phases.summary: Standardizes county, town, and park location references into consistent administrative and coordinate forms so that population and jurisdictional lookups align correctly.

projects.name: HistoricalLandmarkAtlas
projects.summary: A reference compilation that links historical figures, expeditions, and discoveries to the geographic landmarks named in their honor. It serves as a backbone dataset for questions that traverse from explorers to the modern places associated with them.

projects.name: Urban Housing Intelligence Brief
projects.summary: A research brief that traces relationships between urban firms, the workforces they serve, and the residential housing infrastructure supporting those workers in a target city. The deliverable synthesizes multi-source evidence on commercial geography, corporate client relationships, and rental housing economics.

phases.name: Multi-Hop Resolution
phases.summary: The investigative stage where chained inferences across firms, clients, and housing entities are resolved against source data to produce final grounded answers.

phases.name: Preliminary Hypothesis Drafting
phases.summary: An early stage for sketching candidate linkages between business-district firms, their corporate clients, and associated employee housing before formal verification.

phases.name: Scoping & Tool Inventory
phases.summary: The opening stage that defines the brief's geographic scope and catalogs the data sources and tools available for resolving entity relationships.

projects.name: GeoSportsClimateQuery
projects.summary: A research workspace for multi-hop questions that combine geography, sporting events, and climate or weather statistics. Tasks here typically chain entities such as continents, host cities, stadiums, and tournaments before resolving a final factual measurement.

phases.name: TaskDecomposition
phases.summary: Breaks the multi-hop question into ordered sub-questions, identifying the geographic, sporting, and climate entities that must be resolved in sequence.

phases.name: ParallelLookup

phases.name: FinalAnswerSynthesis
phases.summary: Combines the verified intermediate facts into a single concise answer that directly responds to the original chained question.

projects.name: Aviation Incident Briefings Archive

projects.name: Historical Disaster Casualty Aggregation

projects.name: APIBackendIntegration
projects.summary: An engineering initiative to wire downstream services to structured backend APIs that return machine-readable responses. The work focuses on contract validation, response normalization, and integration testing across consuming clients.

phases.name: MachineConsumablePhase
phases.summary: Phase dedicated to ensuring API outputs are returned in clean, parseable formats suitable for direct programmatic consumption without post-processing.

projects.name: ComplianceDueDiligence
projects.summary: A regulatory and ethical review workstream that vets information requests, data sources, and outputs against compliance policies. It serves as a gatekeeping function before sensitive or ambiguous tasks proceed.

projects.name: FloraEncyclopediaBuild
projects.summary: A reference-content project compiling structured entries on plant species, including taxonomy, habitat, and identifying characteristics. Source material is drawn from established botanical references and encyclopedic databases.

phases.name: SpeciesLookupPhase
phases.summary: Phase focused on retrieving and verifying per-species facts from canonical references to populate encyclopedia entries.

projects.name: WWIIEuropeanCasualtyAudit
projects.summary: A historical research project tabulating casualty figures from twentieth-century European incidents, with emphasis on wartime and immediate postwar events. Outputs feed into a consolidated dataset used for cross-referenced reporting on European loss-of-life events.

phases.name: DualVerificationPhase
phases.summary: Phase in which each casualty figure is independently confirmed against two reference sources before being recorded, including arithmetic aggregations across related incidents.

projects.summary: DeepVerify-Encyclopedia is a fact-checking and publication pipeline producing rigorously sourced encyclopedia-style entries on historical events, including religious history and post-WWII conflicts. Each entry undergoes verification of dates, actors, and outcomes before release.

phases.name: publication-draft
phases.summary: The phase in which verified facts are assembled into publication-ready draft entries, with chronological claims and event comparisons checked against authoritative sources prior to editorial sign-off.

projects.name: TimelineCompare-Beta
projects.summary: TimelineCompare-Beta is an experimental tooling initiative for side-by-side comparison of historical events, focused on resolving 'which happened first' questions across mid-20th-century political, religious, and cultural milestones. It is currently in a pre-phase scoping state with no active phases.

projects.name: Cold War & Natural Disaster Timeline Correlation
projects.summary: A research effort that aligns key Cold War political and military announcements with major natural disaster events to compute date offsets and uncover temporal coincidences. Outputs are concise numeric answers (e.g., day counts) supported by verified historical dates.

phases.name: Source Discovery

projects.name: Stock Market Crash Geocoding
projects.summary: A project that maps historical stock market crash events to their geographic origins and affected financial centers. It supports spatial analysis of how financial shocks propagate across regions.

projects.name: US Symbolism vs. Geopolitical Events Correlation

projects.summary: A cross-referencing initiative that aggregates casualty figures from postwar conflicts and civil disturbances (1945-1955), including the Greek Civil War and contemporaneous incidents. It supports arithmetic reconciliation across multiple historical events drawn from the same era.

phases.name: DualEventSummationPhase
phases.summary: Handles paired-event arithmetic tasks where casualty totals from two distinct postwar incidents are retrieved and summed into a single combined figure.

phases.name: RoadmapDraftingPhase
phases.summary: Drafts the sequencing and scope outline for upcoming cross-reference queries, identifying which event pairs will be reconciled in later phases.

projects.name: SpaceProgramCasualtyDossier
projects.summary: A dossier compiling fatalities associated with crewed spaceflight programs and related test incidents. It serves as a controlled reference for casualty-related queries in aerospace history.

projects.name: WWIIBattleProvenanceReview
projects.summary: A provenance review of World War II battle records, verifying the sourcing and attribution of casualty and engagement data. It is scoped strictly to 1939-1945 European and Pacific theater operations.

phases.name: ProvenanceIsolationPhase
phases.summary: Isolates source citations for individual battle records, ensuring each figure is tied to a specific archival or scholarly reference before downstream reuse.

projects.name: AncientEraAtlas
projects.summary: A reference initiative that maps and catalogs major civilizations, events, and geographic shifts from antiquity. It serves as a curated knowledge base for historical questions focused on the ancient world.

projects.name: ChronoCompare
projects.summary: A historical research workflow that compares the timing of notable events to determine relative recency, sequence, and overlap. It supports analyst queries about which of two or more events happened earlier or later, drawing on verified historical records.

phases.name: Event Comparison Reporting
phases.summary: Produces concise comparative answers about the relative timing of two or more historical events, citing the dates used. This phase is where direct 'which is more recent' style determinations are delivered.

phases.name: Live News Alert
phases.summary: Monitors incoming news for newly dated events or anniversaries that may affect ongoing comparisons. It feeds fresh date references into the broader ChronoCompare workflow.

phases.name: Research Gathering
phases.summary: Collects candidate dates, contextual background, and supporting facts for the events being compared. This phase assembles the raw historical material before any verification or reporting occurs.

phases.name: Source Verification
phases.summary: Cross-checks gathered dates and event details against authoritative historical references to confirm accuracy. It ensures that comparisons and timelines rest on reliable, consistent sourcing.

phases.name: Timeline Drafting
phases.summary: Arranges verified events into ordered chronological sequences for review and downstream comparison. This phase produces the structured timelines used in reporting.

projects.name: MusicTimeline
projects.summary: A chronology project tracking milestones in music history, including artists, releases, genres, and cultural movements. It is used to answer questions about when musical events occurred and how they relate to one another over time.

projects.name: BattlefieldGeographyReport
projects.summary: A research project compiling concise geographic profiles of historical battlefields, focusing on terrain features that influenced military outcomes. Outputs feed into a reference report used by historians and educators.

projects.name: ClimateHistoryAudit
projects.summary: An audit project reviewing long-term climate records across regions to verify consistency and identify gaps in historical datasets. The work supports downstream climate trend analyses and reporting.

phases.name: DataIngestion
phases.summary: Collecting and loading historical climate datasets from various public sources into a unified working repository for later validation.

projects.name: GeoPeakComparison
projects.summary: A reference project that produces side-by-side comparisons of major mountain ranges and peaks worldwide, covering elevation, extent, and notable characteristics. The deliverables are short factual briefs used in educational and editorial contexts.

phases.name: AltitudeComparison
phases.summary: Comparing elevation statistics (highest peaks, average ridge heights) between specified mountain ranges to determine which is higher.

phases.name: IntakeClarification

phases.name: NarrativeEnrichment
phases.summary: Adding contextual narrative—geological background, notable peaks, and cultural significance—to the raw comparison findings.

projects.name: ASCII_Only_Export_Pipeline
projects.summary: A utility project that normalizes research outputs into plain ASCII text for downstream archival systems that cannot handle Unicode. It standardizes diacritics, punctuation, and symbol substitution across historical and geographic data exports.

projects.name: Climate_Brief_Generator
projects.summary: A project that produces short, period-appropriate climate and weather briefs tied to historical events for researcher reference. Outputs are concise summaries suitable for inclusion in larger historical reports.

projects.name: Disaster_Weather_Correlation_Study
projects.summary: A study examining whether weather conditions correlated with the severity or occurrence of 20th-century disasters. It pairs disaster event records with contemporaneous meteorological observations for statistical review.

phases.name: weather_enrichment_phase
phases.summary: Attaches historical weather data (temperature, precipitation, wind) to each disaster event record to support later correlation analysis.

projects.name: Maritime_Disaster_Atlas
projects.summary: A curated atlas cataloging notable maritime disasters, including ship fires, sinkings, and harbor incidents, with casualty figures and locations. Entries are sourced from encyclopedic references and cross-checked for consistency.

phases.name: high_confidence_audit_phase
phases.summary: Audits atlas entries to confirm casualty counts, dates, and vessel details meet a high-confidence threshold before publication.

projects.name: Postwar_1949_Disaster_Casualty_Diff
projects.summary: A focused research project comparing casualty figures across notable disasters that occurred in 1949, including industrial accidents, explosions, and maritime fires. Outputs are simple numeric differences between event pairs for use in postwar disaster studies.

projects.name: GlobalTransportAndSportsTriviaAudit

projects.name: NationFormationComparativeAnalysis
projects.summary: A research workstream that compares how and when modern nation-states were formed during the twentieth century, with emphasis on independence dates, founding declarations, and successor-state transitions. Outputs feed into comparison tables used by downstream history and civics content teams.

phases.name: DeepContextNarrativePhase
phases.summary: Produces longer-form narrative context around each nation's formation, including political background and key figures, to accompany the bare date facts.

phases.name: IndependenceDateComparisonPhase
phases.summary: Handles pairwise and small-group comparisons of independence or founding dates between countries to determine which came first and by how much.

phases.name: QuickLookupTriagePhase
phases.summary: Resolves fast single-fact lookups about a country's independence or formation date, often as a precursor to deeper comparative work.

phases.name: TimelineSerializationPhase
phases.summary: Serializes verified formation events into an ordered chronological timeline structure suitable for charts and exports.

projects.name: TwentiethCenturyDisasterRegistry
projects.summary: A curated registry of significant twentieth-century disasters (natural, industrial, and transport-related) with standardized metadata such as date, location, and casualty estimates. Tasks generally focus on cataloging entries and validating dates against authoritative sources.

projects.name: AviationAndAlpineDisasterAudit
projects.summary: An audit-style research workstream that compiles and verifies casualty figures and circumstances from notable aviation crashes and mountaineering disasters. It supports cross-checking of incident details against multiple historical sources.

projects.name: DeepResearchBenchmark
projects.summary: A benchmark suite that evaluates an agent's ability to perform multi-step, evidence-based research across heterogeneous historical and reference sources. Tasks emphasize source reconciliation and traceable reasoning over open-web retrieval.

phases.name: EvidenceTriangulation
phases.summary: Cross-references multiple independent sources to confirm a single factual claim before it is used downstream. Focuses on resolving discrepancies between reference works on the same event.

projects.name: HistoricalCasualtyComparison
projects.summary: A research project that gathers and contrasts casualty counts from disparate 20th-century incidents, including civil unrest, mass shootings, and labor conflicts. Outputs feed comparative summaries used to test factual retrieval and arithmetic reasoning over historical events.

phases.name: DraftNarrativeSummary
phases.summary: Produces concise narrative write-ups of each incident under study, drawing on the verified figures and context assembled in earlier retrieval phases.

phases.name: EvidenceTriangulation
phases.summary: Reconciles casualty numbers reported across encyclopedic, news, and academic sources for each incident to settle on a defensible figure.

phases.name: ParallelSingleHopRetrieval
phases.summary: Issues independent single-hop lookups for each incident's key facts (date, location, death toll) so they can later be combined or compared.

phases.name: SequentialDebuggingPilot
phases.summary: Walks through comparison tasks step by step to diagnose where retrieval or arithmetic errors arise in the pipeline. Used to refine prompts and tool use before scaling out.

projects.name: Bilingual Inventory Pilot
projects.summary: A pilot effort to maintain inventory records in two languages for a small set of household and office supplies. The project tests whether bilingual labeling and reporting improves clarity for mixed-language users.

phases.name: Localized Delivery
phases.summary: Final phase where bilingual inventory outputs and reports are delivered to end users in their preferred language.

projects.name: Community Library Reorganization
projects.summary: An initiative to reclassify and rearrange books and resources in a small community library for easier browsing. The project covers cataloging, shelving logic, and signage updates.

projects.name: Historical Event Research
projects.summary: A research project compiling sources and narratives about selected historical events for a written report. It involves gathering references, organizing notes, and producing draft text.

phases.name: Draft Composition
phases.summary: Phase focused on writing the initial draft of the research narrative using collected sources and notes.

projects.name: Kitchen Pantry Audit
projects.summary: A household project to take stock of pantry items, check expiration dates, and identify what needs restocking. Results feed into a simple shopping and storage plan.

projects.name: Personal Stationery Inventory
projects.summary: A personal project to catalog stationery items such as notebooks, pens, and related supplies kept at home or in a desk. The inventory supports knowing what is on hand and what may need replacement.

phases.name: Initial Data Gathering
phases.summary: Phase for collecting baseline counts and details of each stationery item to populate the inventory.

projects.name: Warehouse Capacity Review
projects.summary: A review of warehouse storage usage and remaining capacity across stock categories. The project supports decisions about restocking, relocation, and space optimization.

phases.name: Bulk Query Execution
phases.summary: Phase where large batch queries are run against inventory data to summarize capacity and stock levels.

projects.name: ArcticIceMonitoring

projects.name: Academic-Citations-Pipeline
projects.summary: An internal workflow for sourcing, verifying, and formatting citations used in academic publications and reference materials. The pipeline emphasizes accurate dates, named entities, and cross-checked historical facts for downstream scholarly use.

projects.name: AstroGeo-Correlation-2024
projects.summary: A 2024 research initiative correlating astronomical events with geological and geographical records to identify potential temporal and spatial patterns. The project compiles dated event tables for statistical comparison across disciplines.

projects.name: Colonial-Era-Timeline-Audit
projects.summary: A historical audit constructing a verified day-level timeline of political, military, and civil events during late colonial and immediate post-colonial periods worldwide. The project focuses on resolving date discrepancies between regional and international sources, including events on the Indian subcontinent and Iberian political milestones in the mid-20th century.

phases.name: ExhaustiveLookup
phases.summary: Deep retrieval phase for pinning down exact dates of specific incidents, elections, and attacks referenced in source documents, including computation of intervals between paired events.

phases.name: InitialScoping
phases.summary: Preliminary phase identifying candidate events and date ranges within the colonial-era window before deeper verification work begins.

projects.name: Seismic-History-Atlas
projects.summary: A geospatial-temporal atlas cataloging historical seismic and related disaster events with verified dates, locations, and impacts. Outputs feed comparative analyses across regions and centuries.

phases.name: DataEnrichment
phases.summary: Enrichment phase that augments base seismic records with contextual historical events and date-aligned references for comparative chronology.

projects.name: Transit-Era-Chronology
projects.summary: A chronology project documenting the transitional decades around mid-20th-century decolonization and political realignment, including head-of-state elections and notable incidents. The work standardizes event dates for use in comparative timelines.

phases.name: CrossValidation
phases.summary: Validation phase that reconciles dates of paired events across multiple authoritative sources and computes day-level intervals between them.

phases.summary: Early-stage phase for capturing event dates, contextual notes, and elapsed-time calculations needed to scope subsequent analysis. Outputs are concise lookups and date-difference computations supporting later timeline assembly.

projects.name: OrgMembershipReview
projects.summary: An audit of organizational memberships and affiliations across entities of interest, confirming join dates, status, and standing. The project supports compliance and reporting deliverables.

phases.name: Verification
phases.summary: Cross-checks membership records against authoritative sources to confirm accuracy and resolve discrepancies.

projects.name: RealEstatePortfolio
projects.summary: A consolidated review of property holdings, valuations, and tenancy details across a managed portfolio. Outputs inform investment decisions and asset reporting.

projects.name: StructuralEngineeringSurvey
projects.summary: An on-site assessment program evaluating structural integrity, load capacity, and material condition of selected buildings and infrastructure. Findings inform remediation planning and safety certification.

phases.name: FieldReporting
phases.summary: Captures on-site observations, measurements, and photographic evidence into standardized survey reports for engineering review.

projects.name: VehicleRegistryAudit
projects.summary: A review of vehicle registration records, historical model introductions, and import documentation to validate registry completeness and accuracy. The audit supports reconciliation between historical milestones and recorded entries.

phases.name: InitialDataGathering
phases.summary: Collects baseline records on vehicle models, arrival dates in target markets, and registration histories to seed subsequent audit checks.

projects.summary: A parallel workstream examining how financial markets responded to the same geopolitical events catalogued in the timeline audit. It correlates event dates with observable market movements to inform risk analysis.

projects.name: NaturalDisasterCrossReference
projects.summary: A supporting reference project that cross-checks geopolitical event dates against major natural disasters to identify overlapping crises. It helps analysts disentangle compounding factors when interpreting historical periods.

projects.name: Aviation Incident Review Project

projects.name: Historical Casualty Comparison Project
projects.summary: A research effort that compares reported death tolls across notable historical events, including natural disasters and recovery operations. Outputs include side-by-side casualty differentials drawn from encyclopedic sources.

projects.name: Cross-Domain Historical Chronology Service
projects.summary: An internal reference service that answers chronology questions spanning political, scientific, sporting, and cultural domains by computing exact dates, gaps, and orderings between historical events. Outputs are designed for quick consumption by analysts who need verified date arithmetic across heterogeneous source material.

phases.name: Compact Tabular Reporting
phases.summary: Produces concise tabular or single-value answers (such as day gaps, durations, or ordered event lists) suitable for embedding in briefings without extended narrative.

phases.name: Raw Data Verification
phases.summary: Cross-checks the underlying event dates against authoritative sources before any chronological computation is reported.

projects.name: Disaster Casualty Quarterly Report
projects.summary: A recurring quarterly publication compiling casualty figures from notable natural and human-made disasters for stakeholder briefings. It standardizes counts, dates, and locations across incident types.

phases.name: Disaster Casualty Quarterly Briefing
phases.summary: Assembles the quarter's verified casualty totals and contextual notes into the briefing document delivered to stakeholders.

projects.name: Opera Performance Timeline Audit
projects.summary: An audit effort that reconstructs and verifies premiere dates, venues, and revival timelines for notable opera works. Findings feed corrections into reference materials used by programming and musicology teams.

projects.name: District-Wide GPA Audit 2023
projects.summary: A district-level initiative to verify and reconcile student GPA records across all participating high schools for the 2023 academic year. The audit consolidates monthly test scores, semester grades, and transcript data to ensure consistency before final reporting.

phases.name: Bulk Ingestion
phases.summary: Raw score files and student records from individual schools are loaded into the central audit database, including per-subject monthly test results across grade levels.

phases.name: Compliance Review
phases.summary: Ingested records are cross-checked against district grading policies and compared across students and subjects to flag discrepancies or missing entries.

projects.name: Westlake High Semester Benchmarking
projects.summary: A school-specific project at Westlake High that benchmarks student performance across sophomore and senior years using monthly test scores in core subjects like English and math. Results feed into transcript generation and comparative student analytics.

phases.name: Final Transcript Export
phases.summary: Validated semester and monthly test scores are compiled into official transcript outputs for each student, including subject-by-subject comparisons.

phases.name: Initial Roster Calibration
phases.summary: Student rosters and baseline score records (including early monthly tests by grade level) are reviewed and aligned with the benchmarking dataset.

projects.name: Art Provenance Verification

projects.summary: An internal initiative that prepares concise briefing dossiers for museum curators on cross-disciplinary exhibits linking literature, diplomacy, and dynastic history. Briefings synthesize background facts so curators can frame exhibits for general audiences.

phases.name: scoping
phases.summary: Defines the thematic boundaries and key figures, places, and artifacts each briefing must cover before any drafting begins.

projects.name: diplomatic_history_project
projects.summary: A research effort documenting historical envoys and emissaries who opened trade routes and cultural exchanges, with attention to their linguistic abilities and the regions they connected. Outputs feed comparative timelines used by other projects in the program.

projects.name: dynasty_atlas_project
projects.summary: Compiles an annotated atlas of major dynasties, mapping their infrastructure projects such as imperial roads, canals, and fortifications alongside the rulers who commissioned them. The atlas pairs geographic measurements with concise historical context.

phases.name: scoping
phases.summary: Selects which dynasties, rulers, and infrastructure features fall within the atlas's first edition and establishes the data fields to capture for each.

phases.name: verification
phases.summary: Cross-checks dynastic facts, ruler attributions, and quantitative measurements (lengths, dates) against authoritative sources before publication.

projects.name: literary_geography_project
projects.summary: Maps the physical places associated with acclaimed novelists and their works, including the landscapes, towns, and natural features near where they lived or wrote. The goal is a reference guide pairing literary analysis with geographic and environmental detail.

phases.name: outline_drafting
phases.summary: Sketches the structure of author-by-author chapters, indicating which nearby landmarks and geographic features each entry will discuss.

phases.name: source_gathering
phases.summary: Collects biographies, regional geographic references, and measurements of nearby natural features (such as waterfalls or rivers) to support each chapter.

projects.name: Historical Ecology Synthesis Initiative
projects.summary: A cross-disciplinary effort to reconcile historical botanical surveys, regional travel ephemera, and modern geographic references into a coherent dataset on landscape change. The initiative emphasizes verifiable multi-source claims linking naturalists, their study sites, and nearby cultural landmarks.

phases.name: Multi-Hop Verification Phase
phases.summary: Analysts chain together facts across encyclopedic, biographical, and geographic sources to confirm linked claims about explorers, the regions they surveyed, and quantitative attributes of nearby natural features.

phases.name: Source Audit Phase
phases.summary: Each cited source for biologist catalogs, regional landmarks, and physical measurements is reviewed for reliability and consistency before being admitted to the synthesis dataset.

projects.name: Marine Biodiversity Audit
projects.summary: A focused review of marine species inventories and the institutional records that underpin them, intended to complement terrestrial work in the broader synthesis program. The audit prioritizes traceability of species counts back to their original surveyors and publications.

phases.name: Source Audit Phase

projects.name: Cross-Domain Knowledge Synthesis Initiative
projects.summary: An internal benchmark program that stress-tests an agent's ability to combine facts from disparate knowledge domains into a single coherent answer. Tasks typically chain together historical, scientific, geographic, and cultural references that must be resolved and arithmetically or logically combined.

phases.name: Complex Task Decomposition
phases.summary: Focuses on breaking compound, multi-hop questions into ordered sub-questions and identifying the entities and facts each sub-question targets before any lookup begins.

phases.name: Parallel Multi-Hop Resolution
phases.summary: Resolves independent reasoning chains concurrently, retrieving the intermediate facts for each branch and then merging the results into the final composite answer.

phases.name: Single-Hop Verification Drill
phases.summary: Spot-checks individual factual hops in isolation to confirm each atomic claim used by the larger synthesis is accurate and well-sourced.

projects.name: Film Award Cross-Reference
projects.summary: A reference project that links major film awards to their underlying source materials, adaptations, and creative teams. It supports lookup tasks that pivot between award records and the books, plays, or real events that inspired the films.

phases.name: Award-to-Adaptation Mapping
phases.summary: Maps award-winning or nominated films to their original source works and tracks adaptation lineage for use in downstream cross-reference questions.

projects.name: Maritime Geography Audit
projects.summary: A reference project covering coastlines, ports, straits, and oceanographic facilities used to ground geography-related questions. It serves as a stable lookup context for maritime locations and associated institutions.

projects.name: Automotive Ecology Review
projects.summary: A research initiative examining the environmental footprint of automotive manufacturing and operation across regional markets. The review compiles emissions data, lifecycle assessments, and ecological impact metrics to inform sustainability reporting.

projects.name: Machine-Readable Literary Statistics API
projects.summary: Development of a structured data service exposing quantitative metadata about literary works, including page counts, edition histories, and biographical reference figures. The API is intended to support downstream analytics tools that compare books against external datasets.

projects.name: Subterranean Heritage Mapping
projects.summary: A cultural heritage program documenting underground architectural features such as tunnels, hidden passageways, and cellars beneath historic fortifications and civic landmarks. Outputs include geolocated records and narrative descriptions of concealed historical infrastructure.

projects.name: UrbanLitHealth Comparative Atlas
projects.summary: An interdisciplinary atlas project that aligns city-level literary heritage (notable authors, biographies, and founding figures) with contemporary healthcare capacity indicators in the same urban areas. The atlas supports comparative narratives between cultural artifacts and public health throughput in a given city.

phases.name: Founder Disambiguation
phases.summary: Identifies and resolves ambiguities around the founders of notable city sites (e.g., wineries, distilleries, or landmark establishments), confirming the correct historical figure tied to a given location.

phases.name: Founder-Hospital Synthesis
phases.summary: Cross-references biographical works about identified founders with hospital operational statistics in the same city to produce paired comparative entries for the atlas.

phases.name: Healthcare Baseline Calibration
phases.summary: Establishes baseline healthcare throughput metrics, such as average daily patients treated, for hospitals in the cities covered by the atlas.

phases.name: Source Identification
phases.summary: Locates and validates primary and secondary sources—biographies, official site histories, and hospital reports—used to populate atlas entries.

projects.name: British Library Cultural Briefings
projects.summary: A reference desk workstream that prepares concise briefings on literary, artistic, and musical heritage topics for British Library curators and visiting researchers. Outputs support exhibition planning and public-facing reading lists.

projects.name: Cultural Cross-Reference Synthesis
projects.summary: A multi-hop research initiative that links together facts across literature, visual art, geography, and popular music to answer complex cross-domain questions. Each query is decomposed into chained sub-claims, verified against sources, and assembled into a single sourced answer.

phases.name: Evidence Annotation
phases.summary: Tag each verified sub-claim with its source citation, confidence level, and the cross-reference link it supports, so downstream assembly can trace every hop.

phases.name: Multi-Hop Answer Assembly
phases.summary: Combine the annotated sub-claim findings into the final composite answer, including any required arithmetic or aggregation across the literary and music branches.

phases.name: Music Branch Disambiguation
phases.summary: Resolve the band-and-song side of the chain, including the band's district of origin and the release year of the referenced hit song, distinguishing similarly named acts or singles.

phases.name: Preliminary Source Scoping
phases.summary: Scan candidate references for the literary chain (novelist, illustrator, riverside locale) and the music chain to confirm enough verifiable material exists before deeper synthesis.

projects.name: Folk Music Geography Mapping
projects.summary: A cataloguing effort that ties traditional and popular music acts to the neighborhoods, districts, and landmarks that shaped their origins. Used to power location-aware music heritage references for researchers and tour planners.

projects.name: Museum Heritage Catalog Audit
projects.summary: An audit pass over museum heritage catalog entries to verify attribution details such as artists, illustrators, depicted locations, and associated literary works. Findings feed corrections back into shared cultural reference records.

projects.name: Etymology and Origins Project
projects.summary: A reference initiative that traces the linguistic roots and historical origins of words, names, and terms across languages. Outputs support glossaries and explanatory notes for downstream knowledge products.

projects.name: Historical Biographies Project
projects.summary: Compiles concise, factual biographical profiles of notable historical figures, including inventors, scientists, and cultural leaders. Each profile emphasizes verified life events, birthplaces, and major contributions.

projects.name: Parallel Multi-Hop Ranking Project
projects.summary: Produces ranked comparisons of quantitative facts that each require multi-hop reasoning across separate entities (e.g., people, places, ecosystems). The project emphasizes decomposing compound questions, retrieving each value independently, and presenting an ordered result with verifiable sources.

phases.name: Initial Decomposition Phase
phases.summary: Break each compound, multi-hop ranking question into independent sub-questions and identify the underlying entity each sub-question resolves to before any retrieval begins.

phases.name: Parallel Retrieval and Ranking Phase
phases.summary: Resolve each sub-question's numeric value in parallel and then order the resulting quantities from smallest to largest (or as otherwise specified) to produce the final ranking.

phases.name: Source Verification Phase
phases.summary: Cross-check each retrieved value against reliable references and confirm that the final ranking is consistent with the verified figures.

projects.name: Scientific Notation Reporting Project
projects.summary: Standardizes how numeric findings are reported by expressing values in scientific notation with appropriate precision and units. Used to harmonize quantitative outputs from other knowledge projects for clear comparison.

projects.name: Interdisciplinary Comparative Query Resolution
projects.summary: A research workstream that handles open-ended comparative questions requiring evidence from literature, geography, demographics, and cultural events. Analysts decompose each query into verifiable sub-facts and reconcile them into a single grounded comparison.

phases.name: Cultural Cross-Reference

phases.name: Geographic Pre-Indexing
phases.summary: Locate the physical features (lakes, parks, cities) implied by the question and pin them to canonical place identifiers before measurement lookups.

phases.name: Multi-Hop Synthesis
phases.summary: Chain the resolved cultural and geographic entities together to retrieve the comparable quantitative attributes and produce the final comparison.

phases.name: Preliminary Source Triage
phases.summary: Screen candidate references for reliability and recency so that downstream synthesis rests on consistent, citable figures.

projects.name: Spatial-Textual Comparative Analysis
projects.summary: A research project that compares quantitative attributes drawn from spatial/geographic entities against those drawn from textual or literary entities, often linking historical figures to places and works. Tasks typically resolve indirect references (e.g., 'the scientist who...') and then compare numeric magnitudes.

projects.name: Cherry Blossom Tourism Atlas
projects.summary: A reference compilation documenting regions worldwide celebrated for cherry blossoms, including their seasonal festivals, signature events, and footrace traditions. It serves as a contextual lookup for cultural tourism research.

projects.name: Heritage Triad Comparison
projects.summary: A cross-domain analytical project that compares numeric facts across inventors, war memorials, and cultural festivals to answer ranking and superlative questions. It integrates findings from the other three reference archives.

phases.name: raw_data_collection
phases.summary: Gather candidate figures (patent counts, tower heights, race distances) and their source citations from the supporting archives without filtering.

phases.name: scoping
phases.summary: Narrow the collected data to the specific inventor, memorial, and festival entities relevant to the comparison question.

phases.name: verification
phases.summary: Cross-check the scoped figures against authoritative sources and reconcile any discrepancies before final comparison.

projects.name: Inventor Legacy Archive
projects.summary: A catalog of notable inventors indexed by city of residence, patent holdings, and contributions to annual technology exhibitions. It supports lookups linking inventors to the cities and events that shaped their careers.

projects.name: WWII Memorial Census
projects.summary: A registry of WWII-era memorial towers and monuments, recording their dimensions, locations, and the war heroes and battles they commemorate. It provides structured data on commemorative architecture and associated military strategy.

projects.name: EuroGeoHistoryQA

phases.summary: Break each compound question into ordered sub-questions and identify the entities and lookups required. The decomposition guides downstream evidence retrieval and final arithmetic or comparison steps.

phases.name: RetryProtocol

projects.name: Cross-Domain Comparative Ranking Analysis
projects.summary: An analytical workstream that produces ranked comparisons across heterogeneous quantitative attributes (lengths, durations, capacities, etc.) drawn from disparate cultural, geographic, and infrastructural domains. Outputs are intended to support knowledge-base entries that require multi-hop reasoning chains with traceable sourcing.

phases.name: Citation Compilation
phases.summary: Gather and document authoritative sources for each factual claim used in a ranking, ensuring every numeric value and named entity is backed by a verifiable reference.

phases.name: Initial Data Scoping
phases.summary: Identify the candidate entities implied by each clue in a comparative prompt and collect baseline figures needed before final ranking synthesis.

phases.name: Multi-Hop Synthesis Reporting
phases.summary: Combine resolved entities and their associated metrics into a coherent ranked output with the reasoning chain explicitly laid out.

projects.name: European Heritage Atlas Compilation
projects.summary: A reference compendium cataloguing notable European cultural, culinary, and historical landmarks alongside the figures associated with them. Entries are organized thematically to support cross-referencing between people, places, and traditions.

phases.name: Gastronomic Heritage Indexing
phases.summary: Index chefs, signature dishes, and the cities or regions associated with iconic street foods and culinary inventions for inclusion in the atlas.

projects.name: Urban Transit Infrastructure Audit
projects.summary: A survey-style project examining major urban infrastructure assets—bridges, stadiums, and transit-adjacent venues—across selected cities to compile comparable structural and capacity metrics.
